summary: Solid production code. Strengths: set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, comprehensive error handling, pinned actions (v4), least-privilege perms, sensible job dependencies, proper GITHUB_OUTPUT handling. Minor issues: sed JSON replacement uses GNU extension (fine for ubuntu-latest but not portable); write_changelog logic is convoluted (multiple branches for similar operations, could consolidate); no validation against leading zeros in versions (acceptable for semver). Functions are well-factored and focused. Regex patterns adequately document conventional commit prefixes. Minor quibble: changelog_section reads commits file twice—could cache. Overall well-engineered for CI integration.
